column1: # SNP barcode of Coll F et al. A robust SNP barcode for typing Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex strains.
# Nat Commun 5:4812 (2014). https://doi.org/10.1038/ncomms5812. Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license.
# From Supplementary Table 3 (SNPs) and Supplementary Data 1 (lineage names and main spoligotype families).
# Positions and alleles on the H37Rv reference genome NC_000962.3. lineage_allele: the allele that defines the
# lineage, "alt" except for lineages 4 and 4.9, whose allele is the H37Rv (reference) allele.
# Name of BOV changed from "M. bovis": M. caprae and M. orygis genomes also carry this SNP (spoligotyper validation).

column8: M. bovis, M. caprae, M. orygis
